info.title: Conan il ragazzo del futuro Movie
info.synopsis: All'indomani di una guerra combattuta con armi magnetiche che causarono terremoti devastanti, un giovane e coraggioso ragazzo di nome Conan si ritrova coinvolto in una grande avventura. Conan vive in un mondo costituito per lo più da oceani; le principali masse terrestri sono state distrutte dalle armi della grande guerra. Incontra una giovane ragazza di nome Lana, e insieme riescono a sventare i piani della città-stato di Industria che vuole riappropriarsi delle armi letali.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath of a war fought by magnetic weapons which caused massive earthquakes, a young and spunky boy named Conan gets involved in a grand adventure. Conan lives in a world that is mostly oceans; the major land masses having been destroyed by the weapons of the great war. He meets a young girl named Lana, and they eventually foil the plans of the city-state of Industria which wants to regain the lethal weapons.

episodes.title: L'assassino dalla White Room
episodes.synopsis: Nuovo anno, nuova app e nuovo esame speciale. Gli studenti di seconda dovranno rapportarsi ai primini.

episodes.title: Contrattazioni e ricompense
episodes.synopsis: La 2-A e la 2-C offrono punti per accaparrarsi i primini. Horikita pensa a una strategia diversa per la 2-D.

episodes.title: La determinazione di un leader
episodes.synopsis: Horikita è determinata a contrattare con Hosen. Karuizawa si confronta con Sato.

episodes.title: Dove si rivolge la lama
episodes.synopsis: Hosen si mostra disponibile a parlare, ma i due leader non sono disposti a cedere su determinate questioni.

episodes.title: L'uomo che vale 20 milioni
episodes.synopsis: In attesa dell'esame successivo, Ayanokoji cerca di scoprire di più sull'esame speciale dato ai primini.

episodes.title: Competizione turbolenta
episodes.synopsis: In preparazione al prossimo esame, gli studenti dovranno valutare se e con chi allearsi tra gli studenti dello stesso anno.

episodes.title: Trame nascoste
episodes.synopsis: Mentre le matricole pensano a una strategia per avvantaggiarsi, Ayanokoji scopre dettagli sull’esame speciale.

episodes.title: Ciò che i draghi osservano
episodes.synopsis: Ayanokoji valuta gli ultimi accordi in preparazione all'esame speciale.

episodes.title: Un inizio inquietante
episodes.synopsis: Con l'inizio dell'esame, Ayanokoji cerca di far punti mentre analizza il comportamento di alcune persone.

episodes.title: Amore irraggiungibile
episodes.synopsis: Ayanokoji e Nanase continuano l'esame insieme, scoprendo cose l'uno dell'altra.

episodes.title: Legami
episodes.synopsis: Il gruppo di Shinohara è in pericolo di espulsione, Ayanokoji cerca il modo per aiutarli.

episodes.title: Oltre il risentimento
episodes.synopsis: Nanase affronta apertamente Ayanokoji. Ichinose fa una terribile scoperta.

episodes.title: Celato dalla pioggia
episodes.synopsis: Con la rivelazione di Amasawa e il maltempo che colpisce l'isola, Ayanokoji cambierà i suoi piani.

episodes.title: Il prodigio straordinario
episodes.synopsis: I compagni di Nagumo affrontano Koenji, mentre il gruppo di Tsubaki organizza un attacco a Ayanokoji.

episodes.title: Forza e volontà
episodes.synopsis: La fine dell'esame è ormai vicina e Ayanokoji è nel mirino di molte persone...

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: While Amasawa delays Horikita, Ayanokoji arrives at the I2 area where a climactic showdown awaits.

info.title: The Irresponsible Captain Tylor
info.synopsis: In un lontano ed ipertecnologico futuro, Justy Ueki Tylor è un misterioso giovane, privo di un vero scopo nella propria vita ed un talento nel riuscire a cavarsela per caso da situazioni di quasi morte con un atteggiamento infantile. A volte sembra addirittura non rendersi conto di quando è in pericolo, cosa che in realtà per lui è un bene in molte occasioni. Grazie ad una serie di incredibili colpi di fortuna che portano Tylor a salvare l'Ammiraglio dell'organizzazione interplanetaria United Planets Space Force da un rapimento, il giovane guadagna il comando di un cacciatorpediniere, con grande disappunto di colui che diventerà il suo luogotenente, Makoto Yamamoto. Tylor e il suo equipaggio di disadattati si troverà quindi a guidare la Soyokaze nella guerra contro l'impero Raalgon, comandato dalla principessa Azalyn, un popolo alieno dalle sembianze di elfo.

episodes.title: Il misterioso irresponsabile
episodes.synopsis:
Tylor joins the army due to his attitude about wanting an easy life with free food and lodging, after talking to the recruiter he is accepted.

He then has an aptitude test with an AI system named Betty.

Due to his charm, he destroys the AI system and the USPF believes it to be an enemy spy, allowing Tylor to join due to the coming war.

episodes.title: La bella vita dei pensionati
episodes.synopsis:
Doing an assignment completely carefree he enters into a hostage situation, meeting Admiral Hanner, Emi, Yumi, and Commander Star.

Due to insane luck while the situation escalates by both, the terrorists activating a time bomb, and the UPSF arming their weapons on the building ready to fire, Tylor resolves the situation with only two injuries, and zero fatalities.

episodes.title: La nave va, ma i dubbi restano
episodes.synopsis: For his heroics in saving Admiral Hanner, Tylor finds himself promoted, and given the position of captain aboard the battleship Soyokaze. But little does realize the Soyokaze is just a dumping ground for undesirables, and it's just a plan on the part of his superiors to get him out of their hair.

episodes.title: Resa incondizionata
episodes.synopsis: The are heated battles between the Soyokaze's marines and their lone fighter pilot, so Tylor decides to try and solve the problem himself.

episodes.title: Un angelo vestito di bianco
episodes.synopsis: Harumi, the new nurse on the Soyokaze, is turning a lot of male heads, including the head of Captain Tylor.

episodes.title: La coda della coda della lucertola
episodes.synopsis: Annoyed by Tylor's recent successes, Admirals Fuji and Mifune attempt to assassinate him by giving him a bomb inside a medal.

episodes.title: Un patto tra gentiluomini
episodes.synopsis: Yuriko is becoming increasinly annoyed by the male crew and their lax attitude toward regulations. She attempt to sort out the problem, but is interrupted by an attack by the Raalgons.

episodes.title: La vita è breve, uccidi, ragazza!
episodes.synopsis: Harumi is ordered to take more drastic action in tackling Tylor. However, he captain is too occupied by the ship's beauty contest.

episodes.title: Ditelo con i fiori
episodes.synopsis: Tylor and the rest of the crew have been demoted. The crew therefore plead to him to appeal the high command's decision in person before a set time.

episodes.title: Aprire le ali e volare
episodes.synopsis: The ship's fighter pilot, Kojiro, who has a strong dislike of women, is forced to train twin sisters Emi and Yumi Hanner as pilots.

episodes.title: Declassate e felici
episodes.synopsis: Yuriko is still annoyed by the crew's refusal to stick with the ship's regulations, especially by Kim's attitudes towards uniform.

episodes.title: La notte che la Soyokaze si fermò
episodes.synopsis:
Everyone on the Soyokaze has heard the tales of how, years ago, a former captain of the Soyokaze and his crew went mad and commited suicide while patrolling the boondocks of space.

Unfortunately, the Soyokaze just happens to be patrolling the same sector of space, on the same date, at almost the same time that the original incident occured!

That can only mean one thing...

episodes.title: Strategia, tattica o nessuna delle due?
episodes.synopsis: Raalgon admiral Donan returns to take his revenge on the Soyokaze. Tylor comes up with a plan to defeat him - sailing directly through the front lines.

episodes.title: L'equazione della gentilezza
episodes.synopsis: Following their last battle, the crew of the Soyokaze face another battle with another Raalgon commander, Sia-Has.

episodes.title: Germi pericolosi
episodes.synopsis: The Raalgon order Harumi to release an engineered virus to infect the entire crew. After it is released, it is revealed that the only way to get the cure is to hand over Tylor to the Raalgons.

episodes.title: Strano amore
episodes.synopsis: While held captive by the Raalgons, Tylor manages to escape and have a midnight feast. However, he unwittingly shares it with Empress Azalyn, leader of the Raalgon Empire. The two soon begin a relationship.

episodes.title: Fuga senza giustizia
episodes.synopsis: Back at the UPSF base the Soyokaze crew learn that Tylor has not been successful in his appeal and is to be killed. They thus plan to escape quarantine and rescue the captain.

episodes.title: Le circostanze di una confessione
episodes.synopsis: The Soyokaze crew are now on the run from UPSF as well as being under attack by the Raalgons, but are determined to rescue Tylor, who is currently working as Azalyn's pet.

episodes.title: La bella addormentata nel bosco
episodes.synopsis: Tylor is injured. It is discovered that the Raalgons have implanted something in his brain and the only way to solve the problems is to synch up his brain waves with those of someone else. Yuriko volunteers, but Azalyn wants to help as well.

episodes.title: Mi fido di te
episodes.synopsis: Following his recovery the marines lend Tylor their most prize possession: a porn film. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Wang is planning a coup to make himself Emperor of the Raalgon Empire.

episodes.title: Paco Paco Junior
episodes.synopsis: Yuriko and Yamamoto want to treat Azalyn as a prisoner of war, while the Raalgons want her to be returned. Not keen on either idea, Azayln attempts to stay with Tylor by claiming she is pregnant with Tylor's child.

episodes.title: Quest'uomo vale un esercito
episodes.synopsis: After Tylor decides to release Azayln, Fuji and Mifune decide to punish him by putting him to death by firing squad. The Soyokaze crew have to rescue him.

episodes.title: Il giorno più lungo della galassia
episodes.synopsis: The Raalgon are on the march towards the UPSF. Tylor however manages to come up with a solution to winning the war, without the Raalgons losing it, and without any bloodshed.

episodes.title: Morte di un ammiraglio
episodes.synopsis: Following his success Tylor is made captain of a new ship, the Aso. However, this means nothing to him after he learns that his most important ally, the retired Admiral Hanner, has died.

episodes.title: Nel modo più triste
episodes.synopsis: While the crew of the Soyokaze are meant to be enjoying themselves, they learn that Tylor has gone missing. Yuriko also learns of something which might restart the war between the UPSF and the Raaglons.

episodes.title: I regolamenti hanno le spalle larghe
episodes.synopsis: With Tylor gone, the crew of the Soyokaze have gone their separate ways and Yamamoto has been made captain of the most powerful ship in the USPF fleet.

info.title: Kaiju Girl Caramelise
info.synopsis: Afflitta da una "malattia misteriosa", la studentessa delle superiori Kuroe ha passato la vita ad evitare il più possibile qualsiasi contatto con gli altri. Dopo aver fatto la conoscenza del ragazzo più popolare della scuola, Arata Minami, qualcosa sembra cambiare all'improvviso e i veri poteri di Kuroe vengono alla luce...

episodes.title: La ragazza kaiju compare a Tokyo
episodes.synopsis: Kuroe è afflitta da una condizione che le trasforma il corpo. Quando conosce Arata, i sintomi si aggravano...

episodes.title: La porta che non si apre
episodes.synopsis: Kuroe, scossa dall'accaduto e dai sentimenti che prova, si imbatte in una ragazza con una strana passione.

episodes.title: Un weekend splendente ~ il Regno dei Sogni ~
episodes.synopsis: Il secondo arrivo di Harugon avvicina Arata a Kuroe, e il ragazzo le propone un'uscita a un parco giochi.

episodes.title: Il terrificante festival del kaiju
episodes.synopsis: Kotaro regala a Kuroe dei biglietti per un festival, ma non sa che anche Arata si trova lì per lavoro.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: A new school year puts Kuroe in class with an unexpected ally.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: A field trip gives Kuroe and Minami a chance to grow closer, while Raimu deals with an unexpected problem.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Arata deals with the fallout of his newfound fame.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Manatsu takes a trip to woo Harugon and invites Kuroe and Raimu to be her wingmen.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Arata's first TV appearance sparks an influx of insecurities for Kuroe.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Kuroe bonds with a kindred spirit while experiencing friction in her relationship with Arata.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: While Kuroe is at rock bottom, a giant flying kaiju threatens the city.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: The threat of the flying kaiju continues as all hope seems lost.

info.title: The All-devouring Whale: Homecoming
info.synopsis: Lingxiao Fan è un talentuoso maestro di spiriti e capo della setta Lingxiao. Durante una competizione tra le principali sette, viene tradito e divorato dal suo stesso spirito animale, una balena chiamata Kun. Al suo risveglio, si ritrova nel corpo di un adolescente di nome Fengmang Liu, prigioniero nella residenza Bai. Nel frattempo, la sua setta è sull'orlo del collasso. Determinato a scoprire la verità dietro il tradimento e a ricostruire la sua setta, Lingxiao Fan intraprende una nuova avventura insieme ai suoi spiriti rimasti e a nuovi alleati come Ling Gu, Xi Cheng e Tong Yue.

episodes.title: A Narrow Escape
episodes.synopsis: A genius youth, Fan Lingxiao, is betrayed by his spirit beast and reborn in disgrace-only to awaken as a notorious rogue.

episodes.title: Falling Apart
episodes.synopsis: The former sect leader returns to Lingxiao Pavilion, only to find it expelled and abandoned by the alliance.

episodes.title: Rallying Again
episodes.synopsis: With the sect on the brink, Fan Lingxiao seeks spirit beasts for everyone-only to fall into a deadly trap.

episodes.title: Identity Exposed
episodes.synopsis: To save their own, old grudges are set aside as the group raids Youyou Hall, while Fan Lingxiao faces an identity crisis.

episodes.title: Brothers at War
episodes.synopsis: Fan Lingxiao allies with Su Muchuan, but the trials force him to fight his former brother, Duan Ye.

episodes.title: The Stronger the Foe, the Stronger We Rise
episodes.synopsis: The team is split into solo battles until overlooked Cheng Xi turns the tide with a last-second counterattack.

episodes.title: A Powerful Enemy Strikes
episodes.synopsis: A hidden enemy targets Lingxiao Pavilion, placing every member's life in grave danger.

episodes.title: Punching Above Our Weight
episodes.synopsis: Fan Lingxiao is mocked by his ex, yet Jiang Rou’er helps her “old love” escape a deadly bind.

episodes.title: Brothers United
episodes.synopsis: Fan Lingxiao leads Lingxiao Pavilion into a united stand against the ruthless Ghost Blade Sect.

episodes.title: Duan Ye Returns
episodes.synopsis: Former brothers meet on the battlefield-will Duan Ye show mercy to Fan Lingxiao?

episodes.title: Life or Death
episodes.synopsis: Zizai Sect launches a fatal strike on Lingxiao Pavilion, leaving everyone on the edge of death.

episodes.title: An All-Out Strike
episodes.synopsis: Backed into a corner, Fan Lingxiao makes his final stand-he must win at all costs.

info.title: Tank Chair (ITA)
info.synopsis: Nagi Taira è un assassino dotato di un'abilità incredibile costretto su una sedia a rotelle dopo aver protetto sua sorella da un proiettile. Il giovane vive in uno stato di perenne stordimento; l'unico momento in cui riesce a ripristinare la sua coscienza, per un breve lasso temporale, è quando percepisce l'intento omicida verso di lui. Intenzionato a risvegliarsi completamente, Nagi inizia la "riabilitazione" su una sedia a rotelle modificata contro ogni sorta di potenti nemici.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Once the city's strongest assassin, Nagi Taira is left unresponsive after protecting his younger sister, Shizuka, and now lives in a wheelchair. Working as an assassin broker, Shizuka takes on assassination jobs and brings her brother to the battlefield for his "rehab." Hoping to fully awaken Nagi, Shizuka accepts a contract to take out Goro Arashiyama, the boss of a notorious robbery gang.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: For Nagi's rehabilitation, Shizuka searches for someone with an even stronger killing intent and sets her sights on Ryo Takanashi, a highly skilled sniper. Takanashi is a deranged man interested only in "good targets." Shizuka asks him to shoot Nagi, hoping his intense killing intent will fully awaken her brother.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Naozumi Kurosaka and his younger sister Touko, students at the assassin-training institution "the Academy" Nagi and Shizuka once attended, arrive on Guicheng Island in pursuit of them. Members of Class A, they suspect Nagi is behind the spate of strange killings on the island. When Shizuka runs into them, they grill her about Nagi's whereabouts, and she finds herself in grave danger.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: The Kurosaka siblings track down Nagi and Shizuka, leaving them cornered. Determined to use even this situation as part of Nagi's rehabilitation, Shizuka provokes Touko, triggering a fierce battle between Nagi and her. Nagi fights in his Tank Chair Mark III: "Iron Fists" but is soon forced into a tough battle when Naozumi joins the fray.
